intro: Every property is different — lot size, slope, how much trimming and edging there is, how wide the gate is and how far behind the growth has got all change the number. Rather than publish a price that turns out to be wrong for your yard, we quote it properly: we come out, walk the property with you, and put the scope and the price in writing before any work starts. The visit and the estimate are free, and there is no obligation to book.
notes: Call (570) 855-0780 for a free written estimate on mowing, landscape maintenance, mulch, clean-ups, pressure washing, weed control or a winter snow contract.
